inputs.name: hand over from CI/CD Pipeline to Containerization

output.level_0: The pipeline crashes on every deploy, leaving the container build step orphaned and unusable.
output.level_1: No container image is produced, so the forecast job runs on bare metal without isolation.
output.level_2: Engineers manually build the container image after the pipeline finishes, causing version mismatches.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically builds and pushes the container image to the registry on every commit.
output.level_4: Container builds are signed, scanned for vulnerabilities, and logged for audit before deployment.
